title: One Swallow Does Not Make a Summer: Understanding Semantic Structures in Embedding Spaces

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the classification of news articles into five ideological categories (Left, Lean Left, Center, Lean Right, Right) using the NewsSpectrum dataset and AnglE sentence embeddings. The performance of the proposed SAFARI algorithm (using Semantic Field Subspaces) is compared against standard baseline classifiers (SVM, KNN, RF, MLP) via F1 scores to see which method best captures nuanced political orientations.
